solutionHi: 5² = 25 का 13 से शेष −1, अतः 5⁴ का शेष 1। 2¹⁰⁰, 4 का गुणज, अतः 5^(2¹⁰⁰) का शेष 1।

question: For how many two-digit numbers N do N and N² leave the same remainder when divided by 10?
solution: The remainder on division by 10 is the unit digit, so N² must end in the same digit as N. Squaring the digits 0 to 9, only 0, 1, 5 and 6 keep their unit digit. Each of these 4 unit digits goes with 9 tens digits (1 to 9): 4 × 9 = 36.

question: What is the remainder when x¹⁰⁰ is divided by (x² − 3x + 2)?
solution: x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2), so the remainder is ax + b with a + b = 1¹⁰⁰ = 1 and 2a + b = 2¹⁰⁰. So a = 2¹⁰⁰ − 1 and b = 1 − a = 2 − 2¹⁰⁰. The remainder is (2¹⁰⁰ − 1)x + 2 − 2¹⁰⁰.

question: What is the remainder when the number made of one hundred 3s (333...3) is divided by 37?
solution: 333 = 9 × 37, so every block of three 3s is a multiple of 37. 100 = 3 × 33 + 1, so the number leaves the same as a single 3. The remainder is 3.
questionHi: सौ 3 से बनी संख्या (333...3) को 37 से भाग देने पर शेषफल क्या होगा?

question: The number 123456789101112...9899 is formed by writing the numbers 1 to 99 one after another. What is the remainder when it is divided by 36?
solution: 36 = 4 × 9. The last two digits are 99 = 4 × 24 + 3, so the number leaves 3 on division by 4. The digit sum leaves the same as 1 + 2 + ... + 99 = 4950 on division by 9, which is 0. The multiple of 9 below 36 that leaves 3 on division by 4 is 27.

question: What is the remainder when x⁷ + 1 is divided by (x² − x)?
solution: x² − x = x(x − 1), so the remainder is ax + b. At x = 0: 1 = b. At x = 1: 2 = a + b, so a = 1. The remainder is x + 1.
questionHi: x⁷ + 1 को (x² − x) से भाग देने पर शेषफल क्या होगा?

question: What is the remainder when (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3)(x − 4) + 24 is divided by (x² − 5x + 4)?
solution: x² − 5x + 4 = (x − 1)(x − 4), which divides the product (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3)(x − 4) exactly. So only the + 24 is left over: the remainder is 24.

question: If x⁴ − px² + q is exactly divisible by (x² − 3x + 2), what are p and q?
solution: x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2), so the value is 0 at x = 1 and x = 2: 1 − p + q = 0 and 16 − 4p + q = 0. Subtracting, 15 − 3p = 0, so p = 5 and q = 4.

question: What is the remainder when 3^(5^(7⁹)) is divided by 8?
solution: 3² = 9 leaves 1 on division by 8, so odd powers of 3 leave 3 and even powers leave 1. The exponent 5^(7⁹) is a power of an odd number, hence odd. The remainder is 3.
questionHi: 3^(5^(7⁹)) को 8 से भाग देने पर शेषफल क्या होगा?

question: What is the remainder when 12^(12¹²) is divided by 5?
solution: 12 leaves 2 on division by 5, and 2⁴ leaves 1. 12¹² is a multiple of 4, so 12^(12¹²) leaves 1.

question: If n is an odd natural number, what is the remainder when n² + 7 is divided by 8?
solution: An odd n is 2k + 1, so n² = 4k(k + 1) + 1. k(k + 1) is even, so 4k(k + 1) is a multiple of 8 and n² leaves 1. n² + 7 leaves 8 → 0.
questionHi: यदि n एक विषम प्राकृत संख्या है, तो n² + 7 को 8 से भाग देने पर शेषफल क्या होगा?

question: A number leaves a remainder of 13 when divided by 15. What is the remainder when (number)² + 4 × (number) is divided by 15?
solution: 13 is −2 on division by 15. (−2)² + 4 × (−2) = 4 − 8 = −4, i.e. 15 − 4 = 11. The remainder is 11.

question: Two numbers a and b leave remainders 4 and 6 respectively when divided by 11. What is the remainder when ab + a + b is divided by 11?
solution: Use the remainders: 4 × 6 + 4 + 6 = 34 = 11 × 3 + 1. The remainder is 1. (Also ab + a + b = (a + 1)(b + 1) − 1 = 5 × 7 − 1.)

question: What is the remainder when 1 × 3 × 5 × 7 × 9 × 11 × 13 is divided by 16?
solution: Pair the factors: 3 × 5 = 15, 7 × 9 = 63 = 64 − 1 and 11 × 13 = 143 = 144 − 1 each leave −1 on division by 16. The product leaves (−1)³ = −1, i.e. 15. (Directly: 135135 = 16 × 8445 + 15.)
